name: reel
summary: Keeps peers at useful widths inside a labelled horizontal scroll region.

agent.useWhen: Peer items must retain useful width and may extend beyond the container.
agent.avoidWhen: All items should remain visible through wrapping or reflow; use Grid instead.

invariants: Label must contain safe visible text.
Children preserve source order and horizontal scrolling remains native.
The focusable region is named and no JavaScript is required.
